symptom: A recorded turn whose snapshot object had been pruned was treated as if the authored path had never existed, allowing reset or Undo to delete the current file.
rule: Validate the full snapshot chain before mutating an authored path; a missing snapshot is a skipped reset, not evidence of a deleted file. Keep Local and cloud on the shared inverse algorithm. See agents/zstack/playbooks/bug-fix.md.
check: pnpm test:git apps/desktop/src/engine/git/__tests__/turns-git.test.ts -t 'skips an authored path when its recorded snapshot object no longer exists'
